## Publication Information

**Date:** 1839

**Genre:** Fiction (modern)

**Publisher:** Chez Jacob & Johnson, Impremeurs, a Winchester: et chez Harris, St. Paul's Church-yard, a Londres.

**Notes:** One of CMY’s rarest works, there are copies at Girton College, Cambridge and in the Bodleian Library.  The characters reappear under other names in <i>Scenes and Characters. Although it was printed privately, it seems to have been advertised for sale by Simpkin, who may perhaps have bought what was left of the stock.</i>
